title: Santa Rosa Island Fire — Landsat 9 false-color 화상 관측, 16,942ac 26% 진압
snippet: NASA Earth Observatory Image of the Day (May 20, 2026). Landsat 9 OLI captured false-color (bands 7-5-3) and natural-color images on May 16, 2026, when burned area was 5,690 acres on Santa Rosa Island, Channel Islands National Park. False-color view shows burn scar in bright red/orange (SWIR reflectance) with active fire front visible in near-IR. By May 19 fire had grown to 16,600 acres (6,700 ha); current extent 16,942 acres, 26% contained. Fire caused by shipwrecked mariner's SOS flare on May 15. Two uninhabited historic structures destroyed. Smoke plume visible over Pacific Ocean. No inhabited structures on island.

before_after.description: Landsat 9 OLI false-color (bands 7-5-3) on May 16: burn scar in bright red/orange, active fire front in near-IR. Natural-color view shows smoke plume over Pacific. Before image baseline available from Landsat archive.
